# Link { #anylumino.Link }

```python
Link(
    href,
    description='',
    variant='primary',
    quiet=False,
    disabled=False,
    **kwargs,
)
```

Spectrum link display control.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type     | Description                                                                                                        | Default     |
|-------------|----------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------|
| href        | required | Destination URL for link controls.                                                                                 | _required_  |
| description | optional | Label shown above the control.                                                                                     | `''`        |
| variant     | optional | Spectrum visual variant such as ``'accent'``, ``'primary'``, ``'negative'``, ``'positive'``, or ``'informative'``. | `'primary'` |
| quiet       | optional | Whether to use Spectrum's quiet visual treatment.                                                                  | `False`     |
| disabled    | optional | Whether user interaction is disabled.                                                                              | `False`     |
